ordering: attempt-major; method-major; subjects in listed order; sequential
replay: first saved failure of every completed search; a replay dry-run ASan abort is retried up to 3 attempts and every attempt is kept
dry_run_abort_policy: aborted_at_dry_run counts in the attempt denominator; it is not replayed and not replaced
replay_unverified_policy: if all replay attempts abort in dry run, record replay_unverified and continue; report the count
stopping_rule: stop for inspection on build failure, timeout, search abort after DBDS started, replay that ran but did not show the expected diagnostic, or changed originals
